FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about stone slinger service.

What is a stone slinger?

Think of it as a giant conveyor belt mounted on a truck. It places gravel, sand, topsoil and stone up to 100 feet away with precision, instead of dumping it in one pile.

How long does a job take?

Most jobs are done in about an hour. On one foundation job, two loads of gravel were spread in about 35-40 minutes.

Do you sell half loads?

Yes. We book half loads of topsoil, gravel, sand and crusher fines, so you don't pay for a full truckload you don't need.

Why does a slinger cost more than a dump truck?

A dump truck drops material in one spot and leaves. You still pay for labour, equipment and time to move it. The slinger places it where it belongs, so the total job usually costs less.

What materials do you supply?

Topsoil, gravel, crushed limestone, crusher fines, screened sand, beach sand, mulch and wood shavings. Call or text to check what's in stock.

Can you load a barge for a water-access cottage?

Yes. If your only way in is by boat, we can sling aggregate or soil right onto the barge.

Do you fill sand and salt sheds?

Yes. We fill sand and salt sheds for contractors, municipalities, property managers and snow removal companies.

Which areas do you serve?

Kirkland Lake, Temiskaming Shores, Timmins, Larder Lake, Matheson, Cobalt and surrounding Northern Ontario.

How do I get a quote?

Call or text (705) 622-3373, message us on Facebook, or send the form with your town, the material and the size of the job. Quotes are free.

Will the truck damage my lawn?

No. The truck stays on the road or driveway and the conveyor reaches out, so there are no tire ruts across your yard.
